top_signals.title: Ukraine warns Starlink limits are disrupting military operations as Russia pounds its energy infrastructure
top_signals.summary: A ballistic missile has struck energy infrastructure supposedly covered by the "energy ceasefire" announced by Trump on Sunday, Zelenskyy said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
